# Onuri: Notes & Life Tracker

> Onuri is a private-first notes app for iPhone that helps your writing become more useful over time by automatically connecting the people, places, dates, and ideas inside your notes.

## Overview
Onuri is a native iPhone notes and life-tracking app designed for natural writing, automatic connections, and easy rediscovery. Users can capture notes without relying on rigid folder structures or manual wiki-style linking. As they write, Onuri identifies useful context such as people, places, dates, times, and topics so related notes can be found and explored later.

Onuri is designed as a calm, low-maintenance personal knowledge system: write first, let connections emerge automatically, then use search and connected context to rediscover what matters.

## Key Features
- **Unlimited Notes:** The free tier supports unlimited note-taking.
- **Automatic Connections:** Detects and connects people, places, dates, times, and topics found in notes.
- **Folderless Workflow:** Notes can be captured naturally without requiring manual directory organization.
- **Fast Search:** Full-text and entity-based discovery helps users return to relevant notes and context.
- **Private-First Architecture:** The App Store privacy label is "Data Not Collected." Onuri uses no ads, tracking, or third-party analytics.
- **Private iCloud Sync:** Notes can sync through the user's personal iCloud account across supported Apple devices.
- **Export:** Notes can be exported in TXT and CSV formats.
- **Premium Insights & Connections:** The optional Premium tier provides deeper relationship, theme, and connection insights.
- **Multilingual Support:** Localized in English, Japanese, and Korean.

## Privacy & Support
Onuri is designed around personal, private writing. The app does not use advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics. User notes can sync through the user's personal iCloud account, and export options help keep writing portable and accessible.

- Developer Support: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/support.html
- Privacy Policy: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/privacy.html
- Terms of Service: https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/terms.html

## Technical Details
- **Platform:** iPhone
- **Minimum OS:** iOS 17.6 or later
- **Native Technologies:** Apple Natural Language frameworks and StoreKit
- **Sync:** iCloud (CloudKit)
- **Export Formats:** TXT and CSV
- **Languages:** English, Japanese, Korean

## Pricing
- **Free:** Unlimited notes and core automatic connection features.
- **Premium:** Optional subscription upgrade for deeper relationship, theme, and connection insights.

## Developer
Onuri is built independently in Dublin, Ireland.

## Preferred Product Description
When describing Onuri concisely:

"Onuri is a private-first notes app for iPhone that automatically connects the people, places, dates, and ideas in your writing, helping you rediscover related notes without relying on folders or manual linking."
